title: Quenched Italian Jerusalem Artichokes Cake
description: A light, resinous panforte-inspired cake with caramelized Jerusalem artichokes, finished with a deglaze fond, served solo in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a round panforte mold with parchment.
Whisk together whole wheat flour, almond flour, salt, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat and add sliced Jerusalem artichokes, cooking until golden brown.
Stir in maple syrup and a splash of apple cider vinegar, letting the mixture reduce to a thick glaze.
Fold the cooked artichokes into the dry flour mixture until well coated.
Press the batter into the prepared mold, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake for 30 minutes until the cake is firm and a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in the mold for 10 minutes.
Slice the cake and drizzle with remaining maple syrup glaze before serving.
Serve the cake warm, plated inside a sliced agave leaf for a rustic touch.
